name: get_host_shell
description: Inspect shell defaults or retained commands on the shared host. Use command IDs to continue work after a handover. Finished handles have bounded retention; full logs remain independently available.

command_id.description: Select a command, or omit to list retained commands.

name: run_host_shell
description: Execute shell code on the shared host. Each start creates a fresh shell. The call waits for completion or yield_ms; a running command returns command_id for continue_host_shell and later completes by callback to its originating session. Returning from a call does not end execution. Results include bounded output and full log paths; final stdout can supply native images.

command.description: Code passed to the selected shell with -c. Keep the same command running to preserve shell state across calls.

cwd.description: Literal working directory; relative paths and the default use the kernel's startup directory.

login.description: Use shell -lc to load the selected shell's login startup files; default false.

mode.description: batch (default) has closed stdin; pipe accepts streamed input; terminal provides terminal behavior with merged stdout/stderr. Batch and pipe preserve output bytes; terminal processing can alter them.

yield_ms.description: Wait for completion up to this many milliseconds; default 1000. This yields attention without stopping execution.

timeout_ms.description: Execution deadline in milliseconds; omitted means no deadline.

max_output_bytes.description: Combined encoded stdout/stderr preview budget; default 16384 bytes. Metadata and native media are separate.

interpretation.description: Present final stdout text, up to 16 KiB, as an image URL passed unchanged to the model service. Image bytes are recognized automatically.

name: continue_host_shell
description: Continue a retained command without starting a new shell. Reads and completion callbacks share the output cursor, including across activities; completion always goes to the originating session. A finished handle can supply remaining output and its native image once, even when the callback supplied only a description. Handles have bounded retention and are not restored after restart.

command_id.description: Handle returned by run_host_shell or listed by get_host_shell; also the command's completion callback ID.

text.description: Input to write, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes. Only one write can be pending; stdin.pending and stdin.error report delivery.

eof.description: After this text, close pipe stdin or send terminal Ctrl-D. Terminal input remains writable.

name.description: Send SIGINT, SIGTERM, or SIGKILL, respectively. Interrupt targets the terminal foreground group; terminate and kill cover its original session. Without a terminal, signals target the command's process group.

action.description: Apply input or control before reading output; omit to read only. Controls remain available while another call waits. Resize requires terminal mode.

yield_ms.description: Wait for unread output or completion up to this many milliseconds; default 1000. Use 0 for an immediate snapshot.

max_output_bytes.description: Combined encoded stdout/stderr preview budget; default 16384 bytes. Metadata and native media are separate.
